Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the critical burial location information from the New York Times obituary results it retrieved. Although the search successfully found the relevant NYT articles (visible in the viewport), the agent did not click on or read the full text of these articles to find the burial details. Instead, it immediately launched a new, repetitive search query without synthesizing the available information. This lack of information extraction from the loaded page represents a failure in its core function (browsing and reading), which ultimately stalled the process of gathering the required independent sources to confirm the answer.
